Order 
This is an application for anticipatory bail.

2. The petitioner is the 1st accused in Crime No.563/2022 of Sipat Police Station, Bilaspur District,
Chhattisgarh State registered under the provisions of Sections 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code .
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is a Neuro patient and is under treatment for 'hypertensive stroke' at Trivandrum Medical College.
Copy of the treatment certificate of the petitioner issued by the Department of Neurology, Medical College, Trivandrum is produced and the same is marked as Annexure 2.

entities.text: Department of Neurology, Medical College, Trivandrum
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is further submits that he is ready and willing to appear before the court concerned and file petition seeking bail.

4. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the opinion that it is for the petitioner to appear before the jurisdictional court at Chhattisgarh State and file necessary petition in this regard.

5. Taking into consideration the request of the petitioner, I am inclined to dispose of the bail application with a direction that the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with the above crime, for a period of one month from today, so as to facilitate him to move the jurisdictional court for appropriate reliefs.
With the above limited direction, the bail application is closed.

Sd/-
VIJU ABRAHAM, JUDGE Dxy Shameer Dawood vs State Of Kerala on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125478703/
